units.source_text: 他摆好架势，准备再试一次，

en.t: He set himself and prepared to try once more,

units.source_text: 女人大声着猛扑过来，紧紧抓住他的手腕。

en.t: the woman cried out and lunged at him, gripping his wrist tightly.

units.source_text: 他撑着手肘，拧着身体想甩开女人。

en.t: He braced himself on his elbow and twisted his body, trying to shake her off.

units.source_text: 可不知怎么计算有误，被愚弄的反而是男人。

en.t: But somehow he had miscalculated, and it was the man instead who was made a fool of.

units.source_text: 他紧跟着就想试着反击。

en.t: He immediately tried to strike back.

units.source_text: 可是铁锹和女人，简直像用锁链连在了一起，毫不动摇。

en.t: But the shovel and the woman seemed almost chained together, and neither would budge.

units.source_text: 不知怎么回事……动武至少该不会输给她，然而……

en.t: What was going on... in a fight, at least, he should not lose to her, and yet...

units.source_text: 两次、三次，他们在泥地间扭作一团，

en.t: Two times, three times, they grappled together in the mud,

units.source_text: 每当他觉得可以将她摁倒时，对方立刻以铁锹柄作为盾牌，轻松地占了上风。

en.t: and each time he thought he could pin her down, she instantly used the shovel handle as a shield and easily gained the upper hand.

units.source_text: 怎么回事，大概是烧酒喝太多了吧……

en.t: What was wrong with him? He had probably drunk too much shochu...

units.source_text: 他脑子里已经没有对方是女人的念头，

en.t: By then the thought that his opponent was a woman had vanished from his mind,

units.source_text: 反射般地用蜷起的膝盖，照着女人的肚子就是一下。

en.t: and reflexively, with his bent knee, he drove a blow straight into the woman's stomach.
